title: Evidence of Manufacturing Process and Quality Control Records

content.scenario: A consumer, Priya, purchases a product that turns out to be defective due to a manufacturing defect. She files a complaint against the manufacturer, providing evidence of the manufacturing process and quality control records to prove the defect.
content.outcome: The court holds the manufacturer liable for the defect, as the evidence provided by Priya proves that the product contains a manufacturing defect, and the manufacturer fails to establish that the product was not defective at the time of sale.

user_queries: What evidence is required to prove a manufacturing defect?
How can a consumer prove a product liability claim?
What is the role of quality control records in a product liability case?
